snippet.title: CAVE CRAVE - RELEASE WINDOW - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Tham Luang Cave is coming to Cave Crave in July.  Explore one of the world’s most iconic cave systems in VR, recreated with the support of LiDAR-based scanning technology to capture its real scale, geometry, and atmosphere. Built in collaboration with cave rescue expert Vern Unsworth and 3D cave-scanning specialist Roo Walters, this new Tourist Mode map brings players closer than ever to the feeling of standing inside the actual cave. The update also introduces long-awaited swimming mechanics, letting players dive into flooded corridors and navigate dark underwater passages with limited visibility and restricted oxygen.
